messages:
alex (docs): Need a concise troubleshooting doc for runtime errors: 429 throttles, client/server timeouts, and context-length failures. Goal: short patterns + tiny SDK snippets (Python/Node/curl) and a full example showing backoff + fallback.

mira (eng-ml): 👍 Agree. Include a short note about reducing context by summarizing long history (send a system summary + last 2 turns) and link to KV prefix caching recommendation.

sam (eng-runtime): For retries we recommend: honor Retry-After when present, otherwise exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 attempts. If still 429, fall back to a cheaper model (we use redwood-mini-1 in examples) or return a friendly error to clients. Example pseudo for Python (using current SDK names):

```python
import time, random
for i in range(3):
    resp = client.createCompletion(model=model, prompt=prompt)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        return resp.data
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        ra = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
        wait = float(ra) if ra else (min( (2 ** i) + random.random(), 8))
        time.sleep(wait)
# fallback to smaller model
resp = client.createCompletion(model='redwood-mini-1', prompt=prompt)
```

sam (eng-runtime): Node variant (v2 SDK) similar but note older SDKs might still use `generate`. For Node streaming abort, show AbortController: `const ac = new AbortController(); fetch(streamUrl, { signal: ac.signal }); ac.abort()`

jen (eng-platform): Ops note: cap retries and avoid retry storms. Also include proactive throttling: read `x-rate-limit-remaining` and `x-rate-limit-reset` (if provided) and back off preemptively when remaining is low. Add a one-line snippet showing check of headers.

alex (docs): I'll add a tiny curl example demonstrating Retry-After handling and a dev tip for testing (use header `X-RateLimit-Test: throttle` on sandbox to simulate 429). Also a short troubleshooting matrix: 429 -> honor Retry-After, exponential backoff, fallback; timeout -> increase client timeout or use streaming/resumable; context limit -> trim or summarize + use embeddings store.

mira (eng-ml): For context limits include a mini example: send `system: summary of convo` + last 2 user/assistant turns. Keep it tiny.

alex (docs): Drafting now and will open PR to docs repo. Planning file: docs/errors/troubleshooting.md with SDK snippets and a small diagram. Will also link SDK migration note for Node rename (generate -> createCompletion).

ci-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/423 — "errors: troubleshooting patterns for 429, timeouts, context limits" (WIP)

alex (docs): PR link up ^ please review inline. I added examples for: Python, Node, curl, and a full backoff+fallback example.

sam (eng-runtime): Quick addition: mention returning HTTP 413 for context-length exceed in some endpoints and a structured error code `context_length_exceeded` in the JSON body. That helps SDKs handle it automatically.

alex (docs): Added that note and a suggested corrective workflow: 1) trim tokens 2) compress history 3) switch to retrieval over embeddings.

mira (eng-ml): Suggest a billing-aware tip: if cost sensitive, consider using a smaller model as default and route complex prompts to the larger model. Short sentence is fine.

jen (eng-platform): Add ops reminder to include metrics: `fallback_count` and `retry_attempts` so customers can monitor. Also emphasize honoring Retry-After.

alex (docs): Done. Anything else before I request reviews?

sam (eng-runtime): Add a note about client-side timeouts vs server-side timeouts and an example of increasing the fetch/HTTP client timeout to match expected model latency.

alex (docs): Will include. Requesting reviews now — tagging teams.

ci-bot: Requested reviewers: eng-runtime, eng-platform, eng-ml.

alex (docs): Thanks all — I'll merge after two approvals. Follow-up: convert snippets to curl + add translation table for older SDK names.

mira (eng-ml): LGTM, leaving review.

jen (eng-platform): LGTM from ops perspective.
